main.description: Replies, likes, reposts and quotes of one of a private account's records, for a viewer who passes its rules: those inside its private space, by actors who still pass the rules, and public ones. Nothing for anyone else. Served and authenticated as tools.umbrae.private.getRecords.

subject.description: The record, in either form: its at:space URI or its public at:// alias.

errors.name: RecordNotFound
errors.description: Missing, or not allowed: the two look the same.
